build_environment_loop: build an EnvironmentLoop instance with a dm_env environment and Acme actor for RL training
run_episodes: run the EnvironmentLoop for a fixed number of episodes using loop.run(num_episodes)
run_steps: run the EnvironmentLoop for a minimum number of steps using loop.run(num_steps)
run_single_episode: run a single RL episode and return logging data with episode length and return metrics
review_environment_loop_class: review the EnvironmentLoop class to understand how it coordinates agent-environment interaction with observers
